name: Kira☆Kano
source:
A collaboration project between Azarashi Soft and Lump of Sugar to commemorate the former's 10th anniversary.

In every class, there is at least one so-called "[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mob_(video_games)]Mob Character[/url]," and this time, it is our protagonist, Hagakure Yuzuru.

Although he does not stand out in the real world, while hiding his true identity in the Online World, he has gained popularity as the virtual Performer, "Yuzuriha Gakuto."

Everyday, he spends his life as a mob character, but on the Internet, a popular person, however..... One day, because he lets his guard down a little, a famous classmate at his school, Kiraboshi Runa, learns of his identity as Yuzuriha Gakuto.

Thinking that he will be taken advantage of from now on, such as giving her money to keep his  secret, Yuzuru falls into despair.

But――

"[b]I beg you![/b], please let me be your [b]apprentice![/b]"

――Runa's request, from what he had expected, is completely different.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://azarashi-and-lump.nexton-net.jp/kirakano/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
Azarashi Soft与Lump of Sugar合作推出10周年纪念项目。

每一个班级中，都至少有一个所谓的“[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mob_(video_games)]Mob角色[/url]”，而这一次，就是我们的主角叶隐结弦。

尽管他在现实世界中并不引人注目，但在网络世界中隐藏自己的真实身份时，他作为虚拟表演者“Yuzuriha Gakuto”而受到欢迎。

每天，他都以黑帮角色的身份度过一生，但在网络上，却是一个受欢迎的人物……有一天，因为他稍稍放松警惕，学校里的一位著名同学基拉星流奈得知了他的身份：柚叶学人。

想到今后自己会被人利用，比如给她钱来保守自己的秘密，结弦陷入了绝望。

但是——

“[b]求求你了！[/b]，请让我成为你的[b]徒弟吧！[/b]”

——鲁奈的要求和他的预想完全不同。

[翻译编辑自[url=https://azarashi-and-lump.nexton-net.jp/kirakano/#story]官网[/url]]
